The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued an orange alert for parts of Karnataka, Rajasthan, West Bengal, Mizoram, Tripura, Sikkim and Kerala for Sunday, August 2, warning of very heavy rainfall accompanied by thunderstorms and lightning.
A yellow alert has also been forecast for several other regions, including Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Haryana, Delhi, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Madhya Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu and Jammu & Kashmir, where heavy rain, thunderstorms, lightning and gusty winds are likely.
A well-marked low-pressure area over southeast Rajasthan is expected to weaken into a low-pressure area over the next 24 hours while continuing to influence weather conditions.
Heavy to very heavy rainfall is likely at isolated places over coastal Karnataka, Kerala, Mahe, south interior Karnataka, Rajasthan, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram, Tripura, Sub-Himalayan West Bengal and Sikkim on Sunday.
Heavy rainfall is also expected over Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Arunachal Pradesh, Assam & Meghalaya, Bihar, east Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat, Haryana, Chandigarh, Delhi, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, Konkan & Goa, Madhya Maharashtra, Odisha, Punjab and Uttarakhand.
Thunderstorms and gusty winds in Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh
The IMD predicted thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds of 40-50 kmph at isolated places over Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Andhra Pradesh, coastal Karnataka, Jharkhand, Kerala, Mahe, Lakshadweep, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal and west Madhya Pradesh.

Thunderstorms with lightning and gusty winds of 30-40 kmph are expected over Bihar, east Madhya Pradesh, Gangetic West Bengal, Jammu & Kashmir, Rajasthan and Telangana. Meanwhile, thundersqualls with wind speeds of 50-60 kmph are likely over interior Karnataka.
Strong surface winds
Strong surface winds are expected at isolated places over Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Mahe and Telangana. Squally winds of 45-55 kmph, gusting up to 65 kmph, are likely along and off the Somalia and Oman coasts, as well as over large parts of the west-central, southwest, northeast and adjoining Arabian Sea.
Similar wind conditions are expected along and off the Gujarat coast, while Karnataka and Kerala coasts, Lakshadweep, Cape Comorin area and adjoining sea regions are likely to witness squally weather with winds of 40-50 kmph, gusting up to 60 kmph.
Squally weather with wind speeds of 40-50 kmph, gusting up to 60 kmph, is likely over the Gulf of Mannar, South Sri Lanka coast and parts of the south Bay of Bengal.
